record_source: Owner instruction to the Claude Code Cloud session (Stage33) continuing Issue #278 / draft PR #287 at 9a3b91169658569eb5702ef24f336b73b84c70ff: maker-compliant large-radius A01 harness and service-envelope design study
subject: A01 J-SIG/J-PWR large-radius routing that respects the wire makers' bend rules, assembly and servicing, in one service model with the installed state, latch access, the 15 mm withdrawal and the core 40 mm movement

broader_change_proposals.header_mounting_face: Moving A01:J-SIG:middle / A01:J-PWR:middle from the A01-middle front face (z 48.4) to its rear face (z 50). The board plane is unchanged, but the footprint side changes, so it is treated as a broader change: proposed for an owner decision, not adopted

fixed: the service order: disconnect K-PWR, then withdraw the core 40 mm
the 15 mm withdrawal basis, the 0.5 mm placement margin and the 0.15 mm K4 threshold
approval_required_before_use: any change to a neighbouring (foreign) board, its outline or its parts
scope_excludes: merging, canonical CAD adoption, KiCad regeneration or fabrication output
ordering, quotes, purchases, uploads or supplier contact
calling a design length a measured or cut length
promoting a calculation to a physical pass
